title: Surreal Cosmic Vision
description: A surreal black and white line art collage features a tall alien-like figure with three eyes and a crystal crown standing amid lavender fields. Multiple laughing human faces emerge from its body while a winding road leads through a landscape containing planets, a red ringed Saturn, skulls, crystal balls with figures, pyramids, and various occult symbols under a starry black sky.
prompt: Surreal black and white line drawing with selective purple and red accents, tall three-eyed alien figure wearing a crystal crown standing in a field of lavender, multiple laughing human faces emerging from its torso, winding black road leading through the scene, floating planets including a red Saturn with rings, skulls, crystal balls containing silhouetted figures, pyramids with symbols, all against a starry black background in a mystical collage style
